overview: I am intervention scientist with training in nutrition, exercise, and behavioral sciences. My lab focuses on developing, optimizing, and evaluating lifestyle interventions for preventing or managing cardiometabolic conditions including obesity, type 2 diabetes, and hypertension. We are particularly interested in developing intervention strategies that can be delivered in partnership with primary care.
